questions.question: In Jetpack Compose, which function retains state across screen rotations (Configuration Changes)?
questions.explanation: rememberSaveable persists state into a Bundle so it survives Activity recreation during configuration changes like screen rotation.

questions.question: To listen for the screen turning on (ACTION_SCREEN_ON) in Android, which approach is required?
options: Declaring the BroadcastReceiver only in AndroidManifest.xml
Dynamically registering the BroadcastReceiver in code via registerReceiver()
questions.explanation: Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_ON is a protected system broadcast delivered only to BroadcastReceivers dynamically registered in code with registerReceiver().
questions.card_front: To listen for the screen turning on (ACTION_SCREEN_ON) in Android, which approach is required?
questions.card_back: Dynamically registering the BroadcastReceiver in code via registerReceiver()
